facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter over CMC issues and need for more evidence · Filed · ONS-5010 in wet AMD · filed for approval

evidence.summary: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a CRL to the Company’s BLA for ONS-5010, an investigational ophthalmic formulation of bevacizumab under development to treat wet AMD.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: While the FDA acknowledged the NORSE TWO pivotal trial met its safety and efficacy endpoints, the Agency concluded it could not approve the BLA during this review cycle
evidence.program_discontinued: the Company is working with the FDA to address the issues that have been raised so that the BLA may be re-submitted.
